unlisted_practices: Require a clinical champion and a multidisciplinary clinical steering group for every ML project before it proceeds.
Examine permutation feature importance and run ablation experiments during development to detect data leakage from features unavailable at prediction time.
Design ML pipelines and feature timestamps to align with production use and data availability at inference time.
Involve clinical champions in defining fairness goals for each use case.

screen.reason: This is a case report/framework roadmap outlining organizational best practices and pragmatic solutions for deploying ML in a pediatric hospital based on institutional experience, rather than an empirical study testing a specific intervention.
